SystemUpdated.query:
SELECT value AS error \
        FROM plist \
        WHERE path = '/Library/Preferences/com.apple.SoftwareUpdate.plist' \
          AND key = 'RecommendedUpdates' \
          AND subkey = 'Display Name' \
          AND value LIKE 'macOS %';

DriveEncryption.query:
SELECT '' AS error \
        FROM disk_encryption \
        WHERE name = '/' \
          AND encrypted != '1';

LockScreen.query:
SELECT 'askForPassword is NOT set' AS error \
        FROM preferences \
        WHERE domain = 'com.apple.screensaver' \
          AND key = 'askForPassword' \
          AND value != 1 \
        UNION ALL \
        SELECT 'askForPasswordDelay too high: ' || value AS error \
        FROM preferences \
        WHERE domain = 'com.apple.screensaver' \
          AND key = 'askForPasswordDelay' \
          AND CAST(value AS INTEGER) > 600;

AutoUpdates.query:
SELECT '' AS error \
        FROM preferences \
        WHERE domain = 'com.apple.SoftwareUpdate' \
          AND key = 'AutomaticCheckEnabled' \
          AND value != 1;

SharingPreferences.query:
SELECT 'Screen Sharing is enabled' AS error \
        FROM sharing_preferences \
        WHERE screen_sharing = 1 \
          UNION ALL \
        SELECT 'File Sharing is enabled' AS error \
        FROM sharing_preferences \
        WHERE file_sharing = 1 \
          UNION ALL \
        SELECT 'Printer Sharing is enabled' AS error \
        FROM sharing_preferences \
        WHERE printer_sharing = 1 \
          UNION ALL \
        SELECT 'Remote Login (SSH) is enabled' AS error \
        FROM sharing_preferences \
        WHERE remote_login = 1 \
          UNION ALL \
        SELECT 'Remote Management is enabled' AS error \
        FROM sharing_preferences \
        WHERE remote_management = 1 \
          UNION ALL \
        SELECT 'Remote Apple Events is enabled' AS error \
        FROM sharing_preferences \
        WHERE remote_apple_events = 1 \
          UNION ALL \
        SELECT 'Internet Sharing is enabled' AS error \
        FROM sharing_preferences \
        WHERE internet_sharing = 1 \
          UNION ALL \
        SELECT 'Bluetooth Sharing is enabled' AS error \
        FROM sharing_preferences \
        WHERE bluetooth_sharing = 1 \
          UNION ALL \
        SELECT 'Content Caching is enabled' AS error \
        FROM sharing_preferences \
        WHERE content_caching = 1;

GuestLogin.query:
SELECT '' AS error \
        FROM plist \
        WHERE path = '/Library/Preferences/com.apple.loginwindow.plist' \
          AND key = 'GuestEnabled' \
          AND value = 1;

BootOptions.query:
SELECT name || ' is set to ' || value AS error \
        FROM nvram \
        WHERE ( \
          name = 'csr-active-config' \
          AND value != '0' \
        ) OR ( \
          name = 'boot-args' \
          AND ( \
            value LIKE '%amfi=0x0%' \
            OR value LIKE '%amfi_get_out_of_my_way=1%' \
            OR value LIKE '%amfi_allow_any_signature=1%' \
            OR value LIKE '%amfi_allow_expired_certs=1%' \
            OR value LIKE '%amfi_allow_invalid_signature=1%' \
            OR value LIKE '%amfi_check_dyld=0%' \
            OR value LIKE '%amfi_unrestrict_task_for_pid=1%' \
            OR value LIKE '%amfi_verify_csignatures=0%' \
          ) \
        );

WirelessNetworking.query:
SELECT DISTINCT '' AS error \
        FROM wifi_status \
        WHERE security_type IN ( \
          'Personal', \
          'WEP', \
          'Open', \
          'Dynamic WEP', \
          'WPA Personal', \
          'WPA Enterprise' \
        );

RemovableStorage.query:
SELECT vendor || ' ' || model || ' (' || serial || ')' AS error \
        FROM usb_devices \
        WHERE class = 8 \
          AND removable = 1;

SensitiveFiles.query:
SELECT REPLACE(path, '/Users/{{username}}/', '') AS error \
        FROM file \
        WHERE path LIKE '/Users/{{username}}/Downloads/%%' \
          AND ( \
            REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), 'password.*\.(txt|xlsx?|tsv|csv|json|ya?ml|conf|ini|pdf)(\..*)?$', 0) IS NOT NULL \
            OR REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), '(backup|recovery|access|secret|private).?(token|password|code|key).*\.(txt|xls|xlsx|tsv|csv|json|ya?ml|conf|ini)(\..*)?$', 0) IS NOT NULL \
            OR REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), '(bitwarden|lastpass|dashlane).*export', 0) IS NOT NULL \
            OR REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), '\.(ppk|pfx|p12|kdbx|1pux|opvault|wallet)(\..*)?$', 0) IS NOT NULL \
            OR REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), '(2fa|authenticator|mfa).*backup', 0) IS NOT NULL \
            OR REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), '(wallet\.dat)(\..*)?$', 0) IS NOT NULL \
            OR REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), '(rootkey|credentials)\.csv$', 0) IS NOT NULL \
            OR REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), 'service.?account.*\.json$', 0) IS NOT NULL \
            OR (filename LIKE '%id_rsa%' AND filename NOT LIKE '%.pub') \
            OR (filename LIKE '%id_ed25519%' AND filename NOT LIKE '%.pub') \
            OR filename LIKE '%seed%phrase%' \
            OR filename LIKE '%mnemonic%' \
            OR filename LIKE '%wallet.dat' \
            OR filename LIKE '%azureprofile%' \
            OR filename LIKE 'client_secret%.json' \
          ) \
          AND ctime <= (strftime('%s', 'now') - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60)) \
          AND (bsd_flags IS NULL OR bsd_flags NOT LIKE '%hidden%');

ExportedFiles.query:
SELECT REPLACE(path, '/Users/{{username}}/', '') AS error \
        FROM file \
        WHERE path LIKE '/Users/{{username}}/Downloads/%%' \
          AND REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), 'export.*\.(csv|tsv|json|txt|xlsx?)(\..*)?$', 0) IS NOT NULL \
          AND ctime <= (strftime('%s', 'now') - (30 * 24 * 60 * 60)) \
          AND (bsd_flags IS NULL OR bsd_flags NOT LIKE '%hidden%');

UnusedFiles.query:
SELECT REPLACE(path, '/Users/{{username}}/', '') AS error \
        FROM file \
        WHERE directory = '/Users/{{username}}/Downloads' \
          AND ctime <= (strftime('%s', 'now') - (90 * 24 * 60 * 60)) \
          AND (bsd_flags IS NULL OR bsd_flags NOT LIKE '%hidden%');
